issues.description: Attribute naming inconsistency: problem_statement.md uses the short names 'inscribedStudents' and 'guestStudents' in the textual attribute list (problem_statement.md line 17), while the UML diagram in the same problem statement and the reference implementation declare the attributes with the full names 'numberOfInscribedStudents' and 'numberOfGuestStudents' (problem_statement.md lines 64-68 and solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java lines 6-10). This mismatch of identifiers for the same conceptual fields (counts of students) can confuse students when they choose attribute names from the textual description vs. the UML, possibly leading to inconsistent implementations or failing tests that expect the 'numberOf...' names.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the attribute names consistent across artifacts. Update problem_statement.md's textual list to use 'numberOfInscribedStudents' and 'numberOfGuestStudents' (matching the UML and the solution), or add an explicit note that 'inscribedStudents' and 'guestStudents' in the text refer to the 'numberOf...' fields. Ensure any tests or example code refer to the same names.
